import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
sub = df[df.account_id=='rNGYton']

# detrend account daily total for weekly cycle: use same weekday-of-cycle baseline
daily = sub.groupby('date')['unblended_cost'].sum()
dates = sorted(daily.index)
pos = {d:i for i,d in enumerate(dates)}
anom = pd.Timestamp('2025-10-20')
base = [daily[dates[pos[anom]-k]] + (daily[dates[pos[anom]+k]] - daily[dates[pos[anom]-k]])/2 for k in range(1,8)]
print("expected vs actual:", sum(base)/len(base), daily[anom])

# per leaf contribution to anomaly residual using seasonal naive (avg of +-7d)
cols=['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']
piv = sub.pivot_table(index='date', columns=cols, values='unblended_cost', aggfunc='sum').fillna(0)
i = pos[anom]
exp = (piv.iloc[i-7] + piv.iloc[i+7])/2
resid = piv.iloc[i] - exp
resid = resid[resid > 20].sort_values(ascending=False)
print(resid.head(10))

import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
sub = df[df.account_id=='rNGYton']
anom = pd.Timestamp('2025-10-20')

for lvl in [['cloud_service'],['application'],['instance_family']]:
    piv = sub.pivot_table(index='date', columns=lvl, values='unblended_cost', aggfunc='sum').fillna(0)
    exp = (piv.loc[anom-pd.Timedelta(days=7)] + piv.loc[anom+pd.Timedelta(days=7)])/2
    resid = (piv.loc[anom]-exp).sort_values(ascending=False)
    print(lvl, "total resid:", resid.sum())
    print(resid.head(4).round(2).to_dict())

df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
sub = df[df.account_id=='rNGYton']
anom = pd.Timestamp('2025-10-20')

# price change detection on anomaly date vs prior days per leaf
leaf_cols=['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']
g = sub.groupby(leaf_cols+['date'])[['price','num_instances']].sum()
piv_price = g['price'].unstack('date')
dp = (piv_price[anom] - piv_price[anom-pd.Timedelta(days=1)]).dropna().sort_values(key=abs, ascending=False)
print("price changes:", dp.head(5))

# residual for 4vxPOsIv4A: compare to what kY8NQIXEVc would have been
fam = sub.pivot_table(index='date', columns='instance_family', values='unblended_cost', aggfunc='sum').fillna(0)
pre = fam.loc[:anom-pd.Timedelta(days=1), 'kY8NQIXEVc'].mean()
post = fam.loc[:anom-pd.Timedelta(days=1), '4vxPOsIv4A'].mean()
act = fam.loc[anom, '4vxPOsIv4A']
print(f"kY8 pre-anomaly daily mean: {pre:.2f}, 4vx expected: {post:.2f}, actual 4vx: {act:.2f}, net delta: {act-pre:.2f}")

{"code": "import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
sub = df[df.account_id=='rNGYton']

# detrend account daily total for weekly cycle: use same weekday-of-cycle baseline
daily = sub.groupby('date')['unblended_cost'].sum()
dates = sorted(daily.index)
pos = {d:i for i,d in enumerate(dates)}
anom = pd.Timestamp('2025-10-20')
base = [daily[dates[pos[anom]-k]] + (daily[dates[pos[anom]+k]] - daily[dates[pos[anom]-k]])/2 for k in range(1,8)]
print("expected vs actual:", sum(base)/len(base), daily[anom])

# per leaf contribution to anomaly residual using seasonal naive (avg of +-7d)
cols=['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']
piv = sub.pivot_table(index='date', columns=cols, values='unblended_cost', aggfunc='sum').fillna(0)
i = pos[anom]
exp = (piv.iloc[i-7] + piv.iloc[i+7])/2
resid = piv.iloc[i] - exp
resid = resid[resid > 20].sort_values(ascending=False)
print(resid.head(10))"}

# price change detection on anomaly date vs prior days per leaf
leaf_cols=['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']
g = sub.groupby(leaf_cols+['date'])[['price','num_instances']].sum()
piv_price = g['price'].unstack('date')
dp = (piv_price[anom] - piv_price[anom-pd.Timedelta(days=1)]).dropna().sort_values(key=abs, ascending=False)

fam = sub.pivot_table(index='date', columns='instance_family', values='unblended_cost', aggfunc='sum').fillna(0)
pre = fam.loc[:anom-pd.Timedelta(days=1), 'kY8NQIXEVc'].mean()
post = fam.loc[:anom-pd.Timedelta(days=1), '4vxPOsIv4A'].mean()
act = fam.loc[anom, '4vxPOsIv4A']
print(f"kY8 pre-anomaly daily mean: {pre:.2f}, 4vx expected: {post:.2f}, actual 4vx: {act:.2f}, net delta: {act-pre:.2f}")"}
